en.title: Right to be told the charge
en.plain: You should be told, in a language you understand, what they say you did.
en.in_practice: If the charge is rushed or in English you do not follow, say you do not understand and ask them to explain.
say: Please tell me the charge in a language I understand.
I do not understand this charge. Can it be explained again?

yo.title: Ẹ̀tọ́ láti gbọ́ ẹ̀sùn
yo.plain: Wọ́n yẹ kó sọ fún ọ, ní èdè tí o yé ọ, ohun tí wọ́n sọ pé o ṣe.
yo.in_practice: Tí wọ́n bá yára ka ẹ̀sùn, tàbí tí Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ò yé ọ, sọ pé kò yé ọ. Béèrè kí wọ́n ṣàlàyé.
say: Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, ẹ sọ ẹ̀sùn náà ní èdè tí mo yé.
Ẹ̀sùn yìí ò yé mi. Ṣé ẹ lè tún ṣàlàyé?

ha.title: Hakkìn a gaya maka tuhuma
ha.plain: Ya kamata a gaya maka, a yaren da kake fahimta, abin da suke cewa ka yi.
ha.in_practice: Idan an yi gaggawa da tuhuma, ko Turanci bai yi maka sauƙi ba, ka ce ba ka gane ba, ka nemi bayani.
say: Don Allah a gaya mini tuhumar a yaren da nake fahimta.
Ban gane wannan tuhuma ba. Za a iya sake bayani?

en.title: Right to a lawyer
en.plain: You can ask for your own lawyer, or Legal Aid if you cannot pay.
en.in_practice: You do not have to answer questions about the case before you speak to a lawyer.
say: I want a lawyer before I say anything about this case.
I cannot pay a lawyer. I want Legal Aid.

yo.title: Ẹ̀tọ́ sí agbẹjọ́rò
yo.plain: O lè béèrè agbẹjọ́rò tìrẹ, tàbí Legal Aid tí o ò bá lówó.
yo.in_practice: Kò pọndandan kó dáhùn ìbéèrè nípa ẹjọ́ kí o tó bá agbẹjọ́rò sọ̀rọ̀.
say: Mo fẹ́ agbẹjọ́rò kí n tó sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ẹjọ́ yìí.
Mi ò lówó fún agbẹjọ́rò. Mo fẹ́ Legal Aid.

ha.title: Hakkìn samun lauya
ha.plain: Za ka iya neman lauyan ka, ko Legal Aid idan ba ka da kuɗi.
ha.in_practice: Ba lallai ba ne ka amsa tambayoyi game da shari'ar kafin ka yi magana da lauya.
say: Ina son lauya kafin in faɗi komai game da wannan shari'a.
Ba ni da kuɗin lauya. Ina son Legal Aid.

en.title: Right to remain silent
en.plain: You do not have to explain the whole story or admit anything today.
en.in_practice: Staying quiet is not the same as pleading guilty. You can say you will speak through a lawyer.
say: I will remain silent. I want to speak through my lawyer.
I do not want to make a statement now.

yo.title: Ẹ̀tọ́ láti dákẹ́
yo.plain: Kò pọndandan kó ṣàlàyé gbogbo ìtàn tàbí kó jẹ́wọ́ nǹkan lónìí.
yo.in_practice: Dídákẹ́ kì í ṣe ìjẹ́wọ́ ẹ̀bi. O lè sọ pé o máa sọ̀rọ̀ nípasẹ̀ agbẹjọ́rò.
say: Màá dákẹ́. Mo fẹ́ sọ̀rọ̀ nípasẹ̀ agbẹjọ́rò mi.
Mi ò fẹ́ ṣe àlàyé nísinsìnyí.

ha.title: Hakkìn yin shiru
ha.plain: Ba lallai ba ne ka ba da cikakken labari ko ka yarda da wani abu yau.
ha.in_practice: Yin shiru ba wai ka amsa laifi ba ne. Za ka iya cewa za ka yi magana ta hannun lauya.
say: Zan yi shiru. Ina so in yi magana ta hannun lauyana.
Ba na so in yi bayani yanzu.

en.title: Right to an interpreter
en.plain: If court English is hard, you can ask for an interpreter in Yoruba, Hausa, Pidgin, or another language you use.
en.in_practice: Do not guess. If a word is unclear, stop and ask for it in your language.
say: I need an interpreter. I understand Yoruba / Hausa / Pidgin better.
Please wait. I did not understand that last part.

yo.title: Ẹ̀tọ́ sí interpreter
yo.plain: Tí Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ilé-ẹjọ́ bá ṣòro, o lè béèrè interpreter ní Yorùbá, Hausa, Pidgin, tàbí èdè mìíràn.
yo.in_practice: Má ṣe fa káàkiri. Tí ọ̀rọ̀ kan ò bá yé ọ, dúró, béèrè ní èdè rẹ.
say: Mo nílò interpreter. Yorùbá / Hausa / Pidgin yé mi sí i.
Ẹ jọ̀wọ́ ẹ dúró. Ìyẹn ò yé mi.

ha.title: Hakkìn samun mai fassara
ha.plain: Idan Turancin kotu ya yi wuya, za ka iya neman mai fassara a Hausa, Yoruba, Pidgin, ko wani yare.
ha.in_practice: Kar ka yi zato. Idan kalma ba ta bayyana ba, tsaya ka nemi a yaren ka.
say: Ina bukatar mai fassara. Hausa / Yoruba / Pidgin ya fi min sauƙi.
Don Allah a jira. Ban gane ɓangaren ƙarshe ba.

en.title: Right to bail consideration
en.plain: The court can consider whether you should go home on bail instead of staying in custody.
en.in_practice: Bail is not automatic. Ask the magistrate to consider bail, and say if you have a surety or an address.
say: I ask the court to consider bail.
I have an address / someone who can stand as surety.

yo.title: Ẹ̀tọ́ sí ìgbéwò bail
yo.plain: Ilé-ẹjọ́ lè wo bóyá o lè padà sílé lórí bail dípò kí o wà nínú ẹ̀wọ̀n.
yo.in_practice: Bail kì í ṣe dandan. Béèrè kí magistrate gbé ọ̀rọ̀ bail wò. Sọ bóyá o ní surety tàbí àdírẹ́sì.
say: Mo ń béèrè pé kí ilé-ẹjọ́ gbé ọ̀rọ̀ bail wò.
Mo ní àdírẹ́sì / ẹnìkan tí ó lè ṣe surety.

ha.title: Hakkìn a yi la'akari da beli
ha.plain: Kotu na iya duba ko za ka koma gida a kan beli maimakon ka zauna a tsare.
ha.in_practice: Beli ba sai an ba ka ba. Nemi alkali ya yi la'akari da beli, kuma ka faɗi idan kana da surety ko adireshin gida.
say: Ina roƙon kotu ta yi la'akari da beli.
Ina da adireshi / wanda zai iya zama surety.

en.title: You do not have to rush a plea
en.plain: A plea is when you say guilty or not guilty. You can ask for time or a lawyer before you plead.
en.in_practice: If you feel pressured to say guilty so you can go home, pause and ask for Legal Aid.
say: I do not want to plead today. I want a lawyer first.
Please give me time to understand the charge.

yo.title: O ò ní láti yára jẹ́wọ́
yo.plain: Plea ni nígbà tí o sọ guilty tàbí not guilty. O lè béèrè àkókò tàbí agbẹjọ́rò kí o tó jẹ́wọ́.
yo.in_practice: Tí wọ́n bá ń fipá mú ọ láti sọ guilty kí o lè lọ sílé, dúró. Béèrè Legal Aid.
say: Mi ò fẹ́ jẹ́wọ́ lónìí. Mo fẹ́ agbẹjọ́rò náà kọ́.
Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, ẹ fún mi ní àkókò kí ẹ̀sùn náà lè yé mi.

ha.title: Ba lallai ba ne ka yi gaggawa da amsa
ha.plain: Plea shine lokacin da ka ce guilty ko not guilty. Za ka iya neman lokaci ko lauya kafin ka amsa.
ha.in_practice: Idan ana matsa maka ka ce guilty domin ka koma gida, tsaya ka nemi Legal Aid.
say: Ba na so in yi plea yau. Ina son lauya da farko.
Don Allah a ba ni lokaci in gane tuhumar.
